model.title: Eliminate PRC Organized Crime Act
model.meta: Foreign Relations Committee · Sen. John Cornyn (R-TX)

summary.text: The bill would establish a program to help law enforcement agencies in Latin America and the Caribbean build their capacity to prosecute Chinese organized crime groups and Chinese government-linked organizations engaged in criminal activities. It aims to provide assistance and resources to strengthen these regional law enforcement efforts against what the measure characterizes as organized criminal threats.
